title: Frequently Asked Questions
summary: Common questions and answers about visiting Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha.

questions.a: The temple is typically open from 6:00 AM to 12:00 PM in the morning and 5:00 PM to 8:30 PM in the evening. Festival timings may vary.
Yes, modest and conservative dress is recommended. Traditional Indian attire is preferred.

questions.q: How can I book a Seva?
questions.a: Sevas can be booked online through our website or by visiting the temple office.
Photography is generally not allowed inside the sanctum. Please check with temple authorities for other areas.

questions.q: Can I volunteer at the temple?
questions.a: Yes, we welcome volunteers. Please contact the temple office or speak with a priest during your visit.

questions.q: How can I make a donation?
questions.a: Donations can be made online through our website or at the temple office. Tax receipts (80G) are available for eligible donations.
Basic accommodation may be available for visiting devotees. Please contact the temple office in advance.

questions.q: What is the nearest railway station?
questions.a: Yelahanka Junction is the nearest railway station. The temple is about 5 km from the station.
